en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a lakeside pier framed by trees in the foreground. A small passenger steamboat named "ÅRAN" is docked at the pier, with several people standing on the boat and on the dock. An early 20th‑century automobile is parked on the wooden pier. Across the water, forested hills and scattered lakeside buildings are visible. Handwritten or printed caption text appears along the bottom right edge.
